messages:
megan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem (INC-10011) 
We had a broad fanout from the cache invalidation job that paged multiple owners overnight. Need a short playbook to reduce noise quickly.
harry: Agree. Short-term: implement a fanout gate in alertproxy that checks distinct host count and route to slack if below threshold. Keep at least one pager per owner group.
zayn: Thoughts on thresholds? I propose: if distinct_hosts < 4 -> slack-first for 5m, else pager immediately. Also bypass if absolute_rate > 1200/min.
megan: Also we should add a sampled audit stream for suppressed events (1% sample) for post-hoc analysis and compliance.
harry: I'll own the proxy change + metric exports. ETA: Wed EOD for a staging PoC. Will emit alerts.suppressed.count and alerts.sampled_suppressed.count.
zayn: I'll own runbook and immediate rollback steps. ETA: Thu. Include a CLI to flip suppression per-service if things go sideways.
alert-bot: Reminder: oncall this week harry -> primary, zayn -> secondary. Use /incident link INC-10011 for tests.
megan: Rollout plan: 1) PoC in staging + synthetic fanout test (48h) 2) canary to us-east for 24h 3) expand if suppressed ratio >50% and repaged_after_suppression < 0.5%
harry: Implementation sketch (pseudocode):
```
fp = fingerprint(event)
hosts = distinct_hosts(event)
owner = owner_group(resource)
if hosts < 4 and rate < 1200:
  deliver = slack
  mark_suppressed(fp+owner, ttl=5m)
else:
  deliver = pager
```
zayn: Add labels: pm_ticket=PM-7002 and suppression_reason=fanout_gate on suppressed alerts. Also a dashboard panel showing suppressed_vs_paged by owner.
megan: Action items:
- harry: implement fanout_gate + metrics + sampled audit stream (due Wed EOD)
- zayn: update runbook + rollback CLI + canary schedule (due Thu)
We'll meet Fri 09:00 PT to review staging results and decide prod flip.
harry: Starting the PR now, will post staging graphs here.
zayn: Thanks all :thumbsup:
alert-bot: Task created: ACT-10011-FU and assigned to harry, zayn.
